title.en: Chapter 14 — The Sound on the River

sentences.ar: الصبح، سمعوا صوت مدفع من النهر.
sentences.en: In the morning, they heard a cannon from the river.
A boat was going round and firing into the water.

sentences.ar: هَك قال: هيك بيعملوا لما حدا يغرق.
sentences.en: Huck said: that is what they do when someone drowns.
Then they understood: the town thought them dead.
The boys were pleased at first.
And then Tom remembered his aunt’s face.
